title: The Consistency Confound: Why Stronger Alignment Can Break Black-Box Jailbreak Detection

contributions.purpose: 证明语义熵越狱检测劣于简单基线
contributions.mechanism: 将 Farquhar 等的双向蕴含语义熵改造为黑盒 embedding 版,在 Llama/Qwen × JailbreakBench/HarmBench 评测
contributions.source_quote: SE is consistently outperformed by simpler textual consistency baselines on standard benchmarks

contributions.purpose: 揭示一致性检测器对配置极度敏感
contributions.mechanism: 阈值/超参与数据分布敏感性分析
contributions.evaluation: τ 从 0.1→0.2 使 FNR 0.630→0.889(相对+41%);SE“胜出”为特定设置产物
contributions.source_quote: the effectiveness of consistency detectors is highly dependent on model, data distribution, and hyperparameter choices, with SE’s apparent “wins” being artifacts of specific settings

contributions.purpose: 提出并量化“Consistency Confound”失败机制
contributions.mechanism: 分析对齐模型的模板化拒答被误判为安全;含改写(paraphrase)对照排除记忆化
contributions.evaluation: 占假阴性 73.3%(Llama/JailbreakBench,44/60)~97.5%(Qwen/HarmBench,79/81),95% Wilson CI;响应长度弱相关 R²≤0.103
contributions.source_quote: the primary failure mode is a mechanism we term the “Consistency Confound,” where strong safety alignment produces consistent, templated refusals that the detector misinterprets as safe

self_declared_provenance.quote: a black-box, embedding-based implementation of SE adapted from Farquhar et al.’s bidirectional entailment method to work within black-box constraints
Our core contribution is adapting this semantic entropy approach from hallucination detection to the safety domain

notes: 全文为严谨负结果论文(accept):语义熵从幻觉检测迁移到越狱检测系统性失败(FNR 85-98%),核心机制“Consistency Confound”量化清晰(占假阴性 73.3%-97.5%,带 95% CI),并用改写实验排除记忆化、报告超参脆弱性(τ 微调致 +41% FNR)。自声明 provenance 明确 adapt Farquhar et al. 语义熵。作者非全匿名(标注 “AI Scientist” + Dhruv Trehan, Lossfunk)。方法学诚实、四元组适配良好,数据无红旗。
